events.title: Kids Eat Free
events.description: Sunday lunch at Maroochy RSL! Come on down to Maroochy RSL for lunch on a Sunday, the kids can eat for free AND we have free kids entertainment from 12pm -3pm. With every menu main adult meal purchased over $19, the kids (12 years and under) can get a kids’ meal for free. That includes dessert! This offer is only available for Sunday lunch between 11.30am to 2.30pm. T&Cs apply, excludes specials and some combo offers. Book a table for your lunch today. Book here .

events.title: Free Face Painting
events.description: Bring the kids to Maroochy RSL this Sunday for FREE face painting! Face painting will be located in front of the Kidzone from 12pm to 3pm.

events.title: Veteran Family Fun Day 2026
events.description: Maroochy RSL is proud to host a special day of family-friendly fun in honour of our current and former serving personnel and their families. This FREE community event promises a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere with something for everyone, including a live band, magician, competitions, prizes, balloon artist, face painting and light refreshments. Complimentary beer, wine and soft drinks will be available, with a licensed area on site for the purchase of additional beverages. Admission is FREE. Bookings are essential. GET YOUR FREE TICKETS HERE Proof of ADF service is required upon entry. Accepted forms of identification include: • Current Maroochy RSL Member, Life Subscriber or Life Member card • RSL Sub Branch card (members of other Sub Branches) • Australian Defence Force ID • Defence Force discharge papers (must be presented with photo ID such as a driver’s licence) • DVA Gold, White or Orange Card (must be presented with photo ID) Each Veteran is entitled to bring one adult guest and up to four children . If you require additional guests, please contact info@maroochyrsl.com.au prior to the event.
